name: Wildmane Cleansing
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young adventurer.  The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.

The Wildmane Water Well lies north of Thunder Bluff.  Perform the ritual!  Heal the land of the goblins' poisons!  Let clean water flow once again!
narrative.objectives: Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You've done it. You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land. Bloodhoof village is grateful, adventurer.

May the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of Mulgore remain clean forever.
narrative.requestItemsText: The last water well remains fetid and poisonous, adventurer.  You must not delay!
